verdict.rationale: Zoho Books has a built-in AI assistant (Zia), so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for it. The evidence only documents Zoho MCP in the server role, which exposes Books to external LLMs and agents such as Claude. Nothing shows Zoho Books or Zia connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools, so server-side evidence earns no credit for this client story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
